title: St. Frances Cabrini's annual jamaica returns Sunday with food, bingo and live music
excerpt: St. Frances Cabrini Catholic Church hosts its annual jamaica Sunday, Nov. 15, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. at 3018 David Ave., with food, bingo, live music and a raffle fundraiser for the parish.
content:
St. Frances Cabrini Catholic Church is inviting the community to its annual jamaica on Sunday, November 15, with food, bingo, live music and raffle prizes, according to KGNS.

The festival runs from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. at the church, 3018 David Ave. in Laredo. The raffle is a fundraiser, with all proceeds going back to the church; raffle tickets bought earlier are still valid, and more tickets are available.

Monsignor James Harris, speaking for the parish, said the event was rescheduled because of weather concerns. The jamaica is open to everyone, offering a day of fellowship, entertainment and fundraising for the parish.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "St. Frances Cabrini Jamaica returns with food, bingo, and more," November 13, 2026
